optional_adapter_network_requirements.prometheus: Read-only outbound HTTP GET to a Prometheus server (opt-in).
optional_adapter_network_requirements.shadow: Read-only HPA/state reads via the Prometheus client (kube-state-metrics); no Kubernetes SDK, no mutation (opt-in).

public_api_notes.ScalingExecutor: Inert Protocol (interface only). No concrete executor is shipped or invoked; the facade/CLI cannot supply or call one.
public_api_notes.ExecutionReceipt: Typed result for an external executor; never produced by this distribution.

operations_code_location: cloud_scaling_operations/ (monorepo-only; not packaged; may become a separate ugence-cloud-scaling-operations distribution in a future, separately-governed phase)

legacy_imports.note: Operational legacy imports resolve to cloud_scaling_operations and are MONOREPO-ONLY; they are NOT part of the distributed wheel and NOT a stable distributed API.

known_limitations: Advisory-only: produces recommendations; contains no code capable of applying them.
Not live-cluster validated by this package; not production-certified.
Decision-deterministic; identity_deviation is a diagnostic that varies before deterministic bootstrap (see output determinism block). It affects no scaling decision.
No cost-savings, customer-validation, or real-cluster-superiority claims are made.
Execution/approval/orchestration code is NOT included in this distribution; it lives in the monorepo-only cloud_scaling_operations namespace.
provenance_policy: The static manifest carries stable metadata only. The actual build revision is generated at build/verification time from GITHUB_SHA or `git rev-parse HEAD` into artifacts/build_provenance.json (evidence_class CI_GENERATED_BUILD_EVIDENCE). No self-referential commit SHA is stored here.
